_help: Fill what you have, leave the rest empty: nothing is rendered for an empty field, so no placeholder ever ships. Then run: python3 tools/build_site.py
_help_host: The public address of the site, with https:// and no trailing slash. Change it when the real domain is chosen, then rebuild: canonical links, hreflang, sitemap, robots.txt, share image URLs and the social cards all follow it.
_help_mode: "preview" shows plainly, next to every request button, that enquiry forms open at launch. Set to "live" once a working backend is connected and tested.
_help_api_base: Only if the forms are served from another address than this site (e.g. https://api.example.ir). Empty = same site.
_help_response: Optional. Fill BOTH only with a reply time the sales team will keep, e.g. fa "ظرف یک روز کاری" / en "within one working day". Empty = the thank-you page states no time.
